meta.title: Marketplace Adapter
meta.description: Brings a packaged skill marketplace into DeepSeek Harness: install once, point it at owner/repo, and its skills appear under package prefixes and refresh automatically. The Marketplace row in the left sidebar lists every source with its revision, sync state, packages and skill counts; /marketplace reports the same status and adds, removes or resyncs sources. Frontmatter DSH cannot read is ignored with a warning.
